name: usability
example: We ran a usability study with eight participants last week.
exampleTrans: 上周我们和八位参与者做了一次可用性研究。

name: user experience
example: Good user experience starts with understanding what people are actually trying to do.
exampleTrans: 好的用户体验始于理解人们真正想做什么。

name: user research
example: User research showed that most customers never open the settings page.
exampleTrans: 用户研究显示，大多数客户从不打开设置页面。

name: participant
example: Each participant received a gift card after completing the session.
exampleTrans: 每位参与者完成测试后都收到了一张礼品卡。

name: interview
example: We will interview twelve nurses about their medication workflow next month.
exampleTrans: 下个月我们将就用药流程访谈十二位护士。

name: usability test
example: The usability test revealed that users could not find the export button.
exampleTrans: 可用性测试发现用户找不到导出按钮。

name: survey
example: We sent a short survey to everyone who canceled their subscription.
exampleTrans: 我们向所有取消订阅的人发送了一份简短问卷。

name: insight
example: The key insight is that users trust reviews more than ratings.
exampleTrans: 关键洞察是用户更信任评论而不是评分。

name: finding
example: I will share the top five findings in Thursday's readout.
exampleTrans: 我会在周四的汇报中分享五个最重要的发现。

name: pain point
example: Slow checkout was the biggest pain point mentioned in every interview.
exampleTrans: 结账慢是每次访谈中都被提到的最大痛点。

name: persona
trans: n. 用户画像；人物角色
example: Our primary persona is a busy parent who shops on her phone.
exampleTrans: 我们的主要用户画像是一位用手机购物的忙碌家长。

name: user journey
example: We mapped the entire user journey from first ad to repeat purchase.
exampleTrans: 我们梳理了从首次看到广告到复购的完整用户旅程。

name: journey map
example: The journey map highlights three moments where customers feel frustrated.
exampleTrans: 旅程地图标出了客户感到沮丧的三个时刻。

name: user flow
example: Let's walk through the user flow for resetting a password.
exampleTrans: 我们一起过一遍重置密码的用户流程。

name: stakeholder
trans: n. 利益相关者；干系人
example: We need stakeholder buy-in before we change the onboarding flow.
exampleTrans: 修改新手引导流程之前，我们需要获得干系人的支持。

name: prototype
example: We tested a clickable prototype before writing any production code.
exampleTrans: 在写任何正式代码之前，我们测试了一个可点击的原型。

name: wireframe
example: I sketched a rough wireframe to discuss the layout with the team.
exampleTrans: 我画了一个粗略的线框图，好和团队讨论布局。

name: iterate
example: We will iterate on the design based on this week's feedback.
exampleTrans: 我们会根据本周的反馈对设计进行迭代。

name: iteration
example: The second iteration reduced task time by almost forty percent.
exampleTrans: 第二个迭代版本把任务耗时减少了近百分之四十。

name: feedback
example: The button gives no feedback, so users click it several times.
exampleTrans: 按钮没有任何反馈，所以用户会点好几次。

name: validate
example: We need to validate this assumption with real customers before building it.
exampleTrans: 在开发之前，我们需要和真实客户验证这个假设。

name: assumption
example: List your riskiest assumptions so we can test them first.
exampleTrans: 列出你风险最高的假设，这样我们可以先测试它们。

name: hypothesis
example: Our hypothesis is that a progress bar will reduce drop-off.
exampleTrans: 我们的假设是进度条会降低流失。

name: onboarding
trans: n. 新手引导；用户入门
example: The new onboarding helps first-time users set up their account in minutes.
exampleTrans: 新的新手引导帮助首次用户在几分钟内完成账户设置。

name: friction
example: Asking for a phone number adds unnecessary friction to sign-up.
exampleTrans: 要求填写手机号给注册增加了不必要的阻力。

name: accessibility
example: We audit every new feature for accessibility before launch.
exampleTrans: 每个新功能上线前我们都会做无障碍审查。

name: intuitive
example: Participants described the new navigation as clean and intuitive.
exampleTrans: 参与者形容新的导航简洁又直观。

name: seamless
example: We want a seamless handoff between the mobile app and the website.
exampleTrans: 我们希望移动应用和网站之间能无缝衔接。

name: empathize
example: Field visits help the whole team empathize with warehouse workers.
exampleTrans: 实地走访帮助整个团队与仓库工人产生共情。

name: empathy
example: Empathy is the foundation of every good research plan.
exampleTrans: 同理心是每个好的研究计划的基础。

name: mental model
example: Users' mental model of folders does not match how tags work.
exampleTrans: 用户对文件夹的心智模型与标签的工作方式不匹配。

name: cognitive load
example: Splitting the form into steps lowered cognitive load for new users.
exampleTrans: 把表单拆成多个步骤降低了新用户的认知负荷。

name: affordance
example: The flat link lacks any affordance that it can be clicked.
exampleTrans: 这个扁平的链接没有任何可点击的暗示。

name: information architecture
example: We restructured the information architecture so help articles are easier to find.
exampleTrans: 我们重构了信息架构，让帮助文章更容易找到。

name: card sorting
example: Card sorting showed that users group billing and invoices together.
exampleTrans: 卡片分类显示用户会把账单和发票归在一起。

name: affinity diagram
example: We clustered all interview notes into an affinity diagram on the wall.
exampleTrans: 我们把所有访谈笔记在墙上整理成了亲和图。

name: synthesis
example: Synthesis took two days because we had over three hundred notes.
exampleTrans: 因为有三百多条笔记，综合分析花了两天。

name: synthesize
example: Let's synthesize the interview data before we jump to solutions.
exampleTrans: 在跳到解决方案之前，我们先归纳一下访谈数据。

name: scenario
example: In this scenario, the user is booking a flight for her elderly parents.
exampleTrans: 在这个场景中，用户在为年迈的父母订机票。

name: use case
example: Offline editing is an important use case for field technicians.
exampleTrans: 离线编辑是现场技术人员的重要使用场景。

name: task completion
example: Task completion rose from sixty to ninety percent after the redesign.
exampleTrans: 改版后任务完成率从百分之六十提升到百分之九十。

name: success rate
example: The success rate for finding the refund policy was only forty percent.
exampleTrans: 找到退款政策的成功率只有百分之四十。

name: heuristic
example: The modal violates the heuristic of user control and freedom.
exampleTrans: 这个弹窗违反了“用户控制与自由”这条启发式原则。

name: heuristic evaluation
example: A quick heuristic evaluation found twenty issues before testing even began.
exampleTrans: 测试开始前，一次快速的启发式评估就发现了二十个问题。

name: screen reader
example: The icon buttons have no labels, so the screen reader announces nothing useful.
exampleTrans: 图标按钮没有标签，所以读屏软件读不出任何有用信息。

name: split test
trans: n. 分组对照测试；A/B 测试
example: The split test showed the shorter headline increased sign-ups by eight percent.
exampleTrans: 分组测试显示更短的标题让注册量提升了百分之八。

name: experiment
example: We will run the experiment for two weeks to reach significance.
exampleTrans: 我们会把实验跑两周以达到统计显著。

name: metric
example: Time on task is the main metric we track for this flow.
exampleTrans: 任务耗时是我们为这个流程跟踪的主要指标。

name: benchmark
example: We benchmark our checkout against three competitors every quarter.
exampleTrans: 我们每季度把结账流程与三家竞品做基准对比。

name: qualitative
example: Qualitative research tells us why users behave the way they do.
exampleTrans: 定性研究告诉我们用户为什么会那样做。

name: quantitative
example: We paired the interviews with quantitative data from product analytics.
exampleTrans: 我们把访谈和来自产品分析的定量数据结合起来。

name: moderator
example: The moderator should stay neutral and avoid leading questions.
exampleTrans: 主持人应保持中立，避免引导性问题。

name: moderated
example: We chose moderated sessions so we could ask follow-up questions.
exampleTrans: 我们选择了有主持的测试，这样可以追问。

name: unmoderated
example: Unmoderated tests let us collect fifty responses over a weekend.
exampleTrans: 无主持测试让我们在一个周末收集到了五十份结果。

name: recruit
example: We need to recruit participants who have filed a claim in the last year.
exampleTrans: 我们需要招募过去一年内提交过理赔的参与者。

name: recruitment
example: Recruitment took longer than expected because the audience is very niche.
exampleTrans: 由于目标人群很小众，招募花的时间比预期长。

name: screener
example: The screener filters out anyone who works in marketing or design.
exampleTrans: 筛选问卷会排除在市场或设计行业工作的人。

name: discussion guide
example: Please review the discussion guide before Monday's interviews.
exampleTrans: 请在周一访谈之前审阅访谈提纲。

name: research plan
example: The research plan outlines our goals, methods and timeline.
exampleTrans: 研究计划概述了我们的目标、方法和时间安排。

name: research question
example: Our main research question is why trial users do not convert.
exampleTrans: 我们的核心研究问题是试用用户为什么不转化。

name: contextual inquiry
example: We did a contextual inquiry at the clinic to watch staff check in patients.
exampleTrans: 我们在诊所做了情境访查，观察员工如何给病人办理登记。

name: ethnography
example: Ethnography helped us understand how families share a single device.
exampleTrans: 民族志研究帮助我们理解一家人如何共用一台设备。

name: field study
example: The field study took us to five farms across two provinces.
exampleTrans: 这次实地研究带我们走访了两个省的五个农场。

name: diary study
example: In the diary study, participants logged every meal for two weeks.
exampleTrans: 在日记研究中，参与者记录了两周内的每一餐。

name: focus group
example: The focus group raised concerns about privacy we had not considered.
exampleTrans: 焦点小组提出了我们之前没考虑过的隐私顾虑。

name: tree testing
example: Tree testing confirmed that the new menu labels are easier to understand.
exampleTrans: 树状测试证实新的菜单标签更容易理解。

name: first-click test
example: A first-click test showed most users looked for search in the footer.
exampleTrans: 首次点击测试显示大多数用户会在页脚寻找搜索。

name: think aloud
example: Please think aloud and tell us what you expect to happen.
exampleTrans: 请边想边说出来，告诉我们你预期会发生什么。

name: eye tracking
example: Eye tracking showed that nobody noticed the banner at the top.
exampleTrans: 眼动追踪显示没有人注意到顶部的横幅。

name: guerrilla testing
example: We did guerrilla testing in a coffee shop to get quick reactions.
exampleTrans: 我们在咖啡店做了游击测试，以获得快速反馈。

name: competitive analysis
example: The competitive analysis covers six apps in the budgeting space.
exampleTrans: 竞品分析涵盖了预算管理领域的六款应用。

name: desk research
example: Desk research gave us a baseline before we talked to any users.
exampleTrans: 在和用户交谈之前，案头研究给了我们一个基础认识。

name: generative research
trans: n. 生成式研究；探索性研究
example: Generative research helps us find opportunities we did not know existed.
exampleTrans: 探索性研究帮助我们发现之前未知的机会。

name: evaluative research
example: Evaluative research tells us whether the new design actually works.
exampleTrans: 评估性研究告诉我们新设计是否真正有效。

name: discovery
trans: n. 探索阶段；需求发现
example: During discovery we interviewed customers, sales staff and support agents.
exampleTrans: 在探索阶段，我们访谈了客户、销售和客服人员。

name: observe
example: We observed three nurses using the system during a night shift.
exampleTrans: 我们在夜班期间观察了三位护士使用该系统。

name: observation
example: Write down each observation on a separate sticky note.
exampleTrans: 把每一条观察记录写在单独的便利贴上。

name: note-taker
example: The note-taker captures quotes while the moderator leads the session.
exampleTrans: 主持人引导测试时，记录员负责记下原话。

name: quote
example: This quote perfectly captures how anxious people feel about the payment step.
exampleTrans: 这句原话完美体现了人们对付款步骤的焦虑。

name: verbatim
example: Include verbatim comments in the appendix so stakeholders can read them.
exampleTrans: 把逐字的用户评论放在附录里，方便干系人阅读。

name: transcript
example: I tagged every transcript with themes before our synthesis workshop.
exampleTrans: 在综合分析工作坊之前，我给每份转录稿都打上了主题标签。

name: theme
example: Three themes emerged across all of the interviews.
exampleTrans: 所有访谈中浮现出了三个主题。

name: pattern
example: We saw the same pattern in both the survey and the interviews.
exampleTrans: 我们在问卷和访谈中都看到了同样的规律。

name: cluster
example: Let's cluster these notes by the goal the user was trying to reach.
exampleTrans: 我们按用户想要达成的目标把这些笔记归组。

name: sticky note
example: Write one idea per sticky note so we can move them around.
exampleTrans: 每张便利贴只写一个想法，这样方便移动。

name: readout
example: The research readout is scheduled for Friday with the product leads.
exampleTrans: 研究汇报定在周五，参加的有各位产品负责人。

name: recommendation
example: Each finding in the report comes with a clear recommendation.
exampleTrans: 报告中的每个发现都附有明确的建议。

name: actionable
trans: adj. 可落地的；可执行的
example: Stakeholders want actionable findings, not just interesting observations.
exampleTrans: 干系人想要的是可落地的发现，而不仅仅是有趣的观察。

name: severity
example: We rated each usability issue by severity from one to four.
exampleTrans: 我们按一到四给每个可用性问题评定严重程度。

name: evidence
example: We have strong evidence that users skip the tutorial entirely.
exampleTrans: 我们有充分证据表明用户会完全跳过教程。

name: sample size
example: Five participants is a reasonable sample size for a usability test.
exampleTrans: 五位参与者是可用性测试合理的样本量。

name: bias
example: Showing your own design can introduce bias into the session.
exampleTrans: 展示你自己的设计可能会给测试带来偏差。

name: leading question
example: "Don't you love this feature?" is a classic leading question.
exampleTrans: “你不喜欢这个功能吗？”是典型的引导性问题。

name: open-ended
example: Start with open-ended questions before narrowing to specific features.
exampleTrans: 先问开放式问题，再缩小到具体功能。

name: follow-up
example: A good follow-up question is simply, "Why was that important to you?"
exampleTrans: 一个好的追问就是简单地问：“为什么这对你很重要？”

name: probe
example: Probe deeper when a participant says something is "fine."
exampleTrans: 当参与者说某样东西“还行”时，要深入追问。

name: consent form
example: Every participant signs a consent form before we start recording.
exampleTrans: 开始录像前每位参与者都要签知情同意书。

name: incentive
example: We offered a fifty-dollar incentive for a one-hour interview.
exampleTrans: 一小时的访谈我们提供五十美元的酬劳。

name: session
example: Each session lasts about forty-five minutes, including setup.
exampleTrans: 每场测试持续约四十五分钟，包括准备时间。

name: remote
example: Most of our interviews are remote, so we use screen sharing.
exampleTrans: 我们的访谈大多是远程的，所以会用屏幕共享。

name: in-person
example: In-person sessions let us see body language and the physical setup.
exampleTrans: 线下测试让我们能看到肢体语言和实际环境。

name: target audience
example: Our target audience is small business owners with fewer than ten staff.
exampleTrans: 我们的目标受众是员工少于十人的小企业主。

name: end user
example: The buyer is IT, but the end user is the sales team.
exampleTrans: 采购方是 IT 部门，但终端用户是销售团队。

name: segment
example: We segment users by how often they place orders.
exampleTrans: 我们按下单频率对用户进行细分。

name: user need
example: Every feature on the roadmap should map to a validated user need.
exampleTrans: 路线图上的每个功能都应对应一个已验证的用户需求。

name: user goal
example: The user goal here is to split a bill quickly with friends.
exampleTrans: 这里的用户目标是快速和朋友分摊账单。

name: frustration
example: Several participants showed visible frustration at the error message.
exampleTrans: 好几位参与者看到错误提示时明显表现出挫败感。

name: delight
example: Small animations can add moments of delight without slowing users down.
exampleTrans: 小动画可以在不拖慢用户的前提下增加愉悦时刻。

name: workaround
example: Users built a spreadsheet workaround because the app lacked bulk editing.
exampleTrans: 因为应用缺少批量编辑，用户自己做了表格作为变通办法。

name: touchpoint
example: Email confirmation is an often forgotten touchpoint in the journey.
exampleTrans: 确认邮件是旅程中常被忽视的一个触点。

name: service blueprint
example: The service blueprint shows what happens backstage when an order is delayed.
exampleTrans: 服务蓝图展示了订单延误时后台发生的事情。

name: empathy map
example: We filled in an empathy map for each persona during the workshop.
exampleTrans: 工作坊上我们为每个用户画像填写了同理心地图。

name: storyboard
example: A simple storyboard helped executives understand the user's situation.
exampleTrans: 一个简单的故事板帮助高管理解了用户的处境。

name: user story
example: Write the user story from the customer's point of view.
exampleTrans: 从客户的视角来写用户故事。

name: task flow
example: The task flow for returns has eleven steps, which is far too many.
exampleTrans: 退货的任务流程有十一步，实在太多了。

name: happy path
example: We designed the happy path but forgot what happens when payment fails.
exampleTrans: 我们设计了理想路径，却忘了支付失败时会怎样。

name: edge case
example: Consider the edge case where a user has no internet connection.
exampleTrans: 考虑一下用户没有网络连接的边缘情况。

name: sitemap
example: The new sitemap reduces the number of top-level sections from nine to five.
exampleTrans: 新的站点地图把一级栏目从九个减少到五个。

name: low-fidelity
example: Low-fidelity sketches keep the discussion focused on structure, not visuals.
exampleTrans: 低保真草图让讨论聚焦在结构而不是视觉上。

name: high-fidelity
example: We only build high-fidelity prototypes once the flow is validated.
exampleTrans: 只有在流程被验证之后我们才会做高保真原型。

name: paper prototype
example: A paper prototype let us test the idea in an afternoon.
exampleTrans: 纸面原型让我们一个下午就测试了这个想法。

name: ideation
example: The ideation session produced over sixty ideas in an hour.
exampleTrans: 这场创意发想会一小时内产生了六十多个点子。

name: brainstorm
example: Let's brainstorm ways to make the waiting time feel shorter.
exampleTrans: 我们来头脑风暴，看怎么让等待时间感觉更短。

name: workshop
example: We ran a two-day workshop to align on the product vision.
exampleTrans: 我们举办了为期两天的工作坊来统一产品愿景。

name: design thinking
example: Design thinking gives the team a shared process for solving problems.
exampleTrans: 设计思维为团队提供了解决问题的共同流程。

name: problem statement
example: A clear problem statement keeps the team from solving the wrong problem.
exampleTrans: 清晰的问题陈述能防止团队解决错误的问题。

name: how might we
trans: phr. 我们可以如何（HMW 提问）
example: How might we make returns feel effortless for first-time buyers?
exampleTrans: 我们可以如何让首次购买者觉得退货毫不费力？

name: design sprint
example: In a five-day design sprint we went from problem to tested prototype.
exampleTrans: 在五天的设计冲刺中，我们从问题走到了经过测试的原型。

name: human-centered
example: We follow a human-centered process from discovery to delivery.
exampleTrans: 从探索到交付，我们都遵循以人为本的流程。

name: user-centered
example: User-centered design means involving users at every stage.
exampleTrans: 以用户为中心的设计意味着在每个阶段都让用户参与。

name: co-design
example: We invited teachers to co-design the grading tool with us.
exampleTrans: 我们邀请老师和我们一起共同设计评分工具。

name: interaction design
example: Interaction design defines how the product responds to each user action.
exampleTrans: 交互设计定义了产品如何回应用户的每个操作。

name: microinteraction
example: A small microinteraction confirms that the item was added to the cart.
exampleTrans: 一个小小的微交互确认商品已加入购物车。

name: navigation
example: Users got lost because the navigation changed between sections.
exampleTrans: 因为各栏目之间导航不一致，用户迷失了方向。

name: discoverability
example: Hiding the feature in a menu hurts its discoverability.
exampleTrans: 把功能藏在菜单里会降低它的可发现性。

name: findability
example: Better labels improved the findability of key help articles.
exampleTrans: 更好的标签提升了关键帮助文章的可查找性。

name: learnability
example: Learnability matters most for tools people only use once a year.
exampleTrans: 对于一年只用一次的工具，易学性最重要。

name: consistency
example: Consistency across screens helps users predict what will happen next.
exampleTrans: 界面间的一致性帮助用户预测接下来会发生什么。

name: error prevention
example: Error prevention is better than a helpful error message.
exampleTrans: 防止出错比给出有用的错误提示更好。

name: error message
example: The error message should explain how to fix the problem.
exampleTrans: 错误提示应说明如何解决问题。

name: empty state
example: A friendly empty state can guide users toward their first action.
exampleTrans: 友好的空状态可以引导用户完成第一个操作。

name: progressive disclosure
example: Progressive disclosure keeps advanced options out of the way until needed.
exampleTrans: 渐进式披露让高级选项在需要之前不碍事。

name: call to action
example: The call to action is buried below three paragraphs of text.
exampleTrans: 行动号召按钮被埋在三段文字下面。

name: user interface
example: The user interface should get out of the way of the task.
exampleTrans: 用户界面不应妨碍用户完成任务。

name: interaction pattern
example: Swipe to delete is a familiar interaction pattern on mobile.
exampleTrans: 滑动删除是移动端常见的交互模式。

name: dark pattern
trans: n. 黑暗模式；欺骗性设计
example: Hiding the cancel button is a dark pattern that damages trust.
exampleTrans: 隐藏取消按钮是一种损害信任的欺骗性设计。

name: signifier
example: An underline is a strong signifier that text is a link.
exampleTrans: 下划线是文字可点击的强烈指示。

name: constraint
example: Graying out invalid dates is a helpful constraint for users.
exampleTrans: 把无效日期置灰对用户来说是有益的约束。

name: default
example: Most people never change the default, so choose it carefully.
exampleTrans: 大多数人从不修改默认值，所以要谨慎选择。

name: undo
example: Offering undo is friendlier than asking users to confirm every action.
exampleTrans: 提供撤销比让用户确认每个操作更友好。

name: confirmation
example: Show a confirmation so users know the payment went through.
exampleTrans: 显示确认信息，让用户知道付款已成功。

name: notification
example: Too many notifications led users to turn them all off.
exampleTrans: 通知太多导致用户把它们全部关掉了。

name: personalization
example: Personalization only helps if users understand why they see each item.
exampleTrans: 只有用户理解为什么会看到每项内容时，个性化才有帮助。

name: conversion
example: Removing the extra step improved conversion on the sign-up page.
exampleTrans: 去掉多余的一步提升了注册页的转化。

name: conversion rate
example: The conversion rate dropped after we added the account requirement.
exampleTrans: 我们加上必须注册的要求后，转化率下降了。

name: drop-off
example: The biggest drop-off happens on the shipping details screen.
exampleTrans: 最大的流失发生在填写配送信息的页面。

name: funnel
example: We analyzed the funnel to see where users abandon checkout.
exampleTrans: 我们分析了漏斗，看用户在哪里放弃结账。

name: retention
example: Better onboarding improved thirty-day retention by twelve percent.
exampleTrans: 更好的新手引导把三十天留存率提升了百分之十二。

name: engagement
example: Engagement rose once we added reminders for unfinished lessons.
exampleTrans: 我们为未完成的课程加上提醒后，活跃度提高了。

name: churn
example: Exit interviews help us understand why customers churn.
exampleTrans: 离职式访谈帮助我们理解客户为什么流失。

name: adoption
example: Adoption of the new dashboard was low among long-time users.
exampleTrans: 老用户对新仪表盘的使用率很低。

name: time on task
example: Time on task dropped from four minutes to ninety seconds.
exampleTrans: 任务耗时从四分钟降到了九十秒。

name: error rate
example: The error rate on the date field was surprisingly high.
exampleTrans: 日期字段的错误率出奇地高。

name: satisfaction
example: Satisfaction scores improved after we simplified the billing page.
exampleTrans: 我们简化账单页面后，满意度得分提升了。

name: net promoter score
example: Our net promoter score rose by ten points this quarter.
exampleTrans: 本季度我们的净推荐值提升了十分。

name: system usability scale
example: We use the system usability scale after every round of testing.
exampleTrans: 每轮测试后我们都会使用系统可用性量表。

name: Likert scale
example: Answers were collected on a five-point likert scale.
exampleTrans: 答案是用五点李克特量表收集的。

name: analytics
example: Analytics tell us what happened, and interviews tell us why.
exampleTrans: 数据分析告诉我们发生了什么，访谈告诉我们为什么。

name: heatmap
example: The heatmap shows people clicking on images that are not links.
exampleTrans: 热力图显示人们在点击并不是链接的图片。

name: session recording
example: Session recordings revealed users scrolling back and forth looking for prices.
exampleTrans: 会话录屏显示用户来回滚动寻找价格。

name: triangulate
trans: v. 三角验证；多方印证
example: We triangulate interview findings with analytics and support tickets.
exampleTrans: 我们用数据分析和客服工单来多方印证访谈发现。

name: statistically significant
example: The difference between versions was not statistically significant.
exampleTrans: 两个版本之间的差异在统计上并不显著。

name: baseline
example: We measured a baseline before the redesign so we can compare later.
exampleTrans: 改版前我们测量了基线，以便之后对比。

name: inclusive design
example: Inclusive design considers people with temporary and situational disabilities too.
exampleTrans: 包容性设计也会考虑暂时性和情境性障碍的人群。

name: assistive technology
example: We tested the flow with several types of assistive technology.
exampleTrans: 我们用几种辅助技术测试了这个流程。

name: color contrast
example: Low color contrast makes the warning text hard to read outdoors.
exampleTrans: 颜色对比度低让警告文字在户外很难看清。

name: alt text
example: Every meaningful image needs alt text for screen reader users.
exampleTrans: 每张有意义的图片都需要为读屏用户提供替代文本。

name: keyboard navigation
example: Keyboard navigation breaks as soon as the payment dialog opens.
exampleTrans: 付款对话框一打开，键盘导航就失效了。

name: focus order
example: The focus order jumps from the header straight to the footer.
exampleTrans: 焦点顺序从页头直接跳到了页脚。

name: impairment
example: We recruited two participants with visual impairments for this round.
exampleTrans: 这一轮我们招募了两位有视觉障碍的参与者。

name: compliance
example: Accessibility compliance is required before we can sell to government clients.
exampleTrans: 在向政府客户销售之前，必须做到无障碍合规。

name: plain language
example: Use plain language instead of legal terms on the consent screen.
exampleTrans: 在同意页面上用简明语言代替法律术语。

name: UX writing
example: Good ux writing made the error messages much less stressful.
exampleTrans: 好的用户体验文案让错误提示变得没那么令人紧张。

name: microcopy
example: A single line of microcopy explained why we need the phone number.
exampleTrans: 一行微文案解释了我们为什么需要手机号。

name: tone of voice
example: Our tone of voice should feel calm, especially during errors.
exampleTrans: 我们的语气风格应当平和，尤其是在出错时。

name: trust
example: Showing security badges near payment helped build trust.
exampleTrans: 在支付附近展示安全标识有助于建立信任。

name: anxiety
example: Unclear pricing created a lot of anxiety right before checkout.
exampleTrans: 不清楚的定价在结账前引发了很多焦虑。

name: confusing
example: Most participants found the new pricing table confusing and hard to compare.
exampleTrans: 大多数参与者觉得新的价格表令人困惑，难以比较。

name: straightforward
example: Participants said the new booking flow was straightforward.
exampleTrans: 参与者说新的预订流程简单明了。

name: frictionless
example: A frictionless sign-up lets people explore before creating an account.
exampleTrans: 顺畅的注册让人们在创建账户前就能先体验。

name: user-friendly
example: Stakeholders want it user-friendly, so let's define what that means.
exampleTrans: 干系人希望它对用户友好，那我们先定义一下这意味着什么。

name: discoverable
example: The filter is not discoverable unless you already know it exists.
exampleTrans: 除非你已经知道它存在，否则这个筛选功能很难被发现。

name: inclusive
example: We rewrote the gender question to make it more inclusive.
exampleTrans: 我们重写了性别问题，让它更具包容性。

name: accessible
trans: adj. 无障碍的；易于使用的
example: The chart is not accessible to people who cannot see color.
exampleTrans: 这个图表对色盲人群来说不可用。

name: unmet need
example: The interviews revealed an unmet need for shared family calendars.
exampleTrans: 访谈揭示了对家庭共享日历的未满足需求。

name: opportunity
example: There is a big opportunity to simplify how teams share files.
exampleTrans: 简化团队共享文件的方式是一个很大的机会。

name: opportunity area
example: We identified four opportunity areas for the next planning cycle.
exampleTrans: 我们为下一个规划周期确定了四个机会领域。

name: prioritize
example: Let's prioritize the issues that block users from finishing the task.
exampleTrans: 我们优先处理那些阻碍用户完成任务的问题。

name: prioritization
example: We used an impact versus effort matrix for prioritization.
exampleTrans: 我们用影响度与投入度矩阵来做优先级排序。

name: trade-off
example: There is a trade-off between flexibility and simplicity here.
exampleTrans: 这里需要在灵活性和简洁性之间权衡。

name: rationale
example: Please document the design rationale so others understand our decision.
exampleTrans: 请记录设计依据，让其他人理解我们的决定。

name: advocate
example: Researchers advocate for users when roadmap decisions are made.
exampleTrans: 在制定路线图时，研究员为用户发声。

name: align
example: We need to align with product on the scope before the next round.
exampleTrans: 下一轮之前，我们需要和产品在范围上达成一致。

name: alignment
example: The workshop created alignment between design, engineering and sales.
exampleTrans: 这次工作坊让设计、工程和销售达成了共识。

name: buy-in
example: Inviting stakeholders to observe sessions is the fastest way to get buy-in.
exampleTrans: 邀请干系人旁听测试是获得认同最快的方式。

name: handoff
example: The handoff to developers includes annotated flows and edge cases.
exampleTrans: 交付给开发的内容包括带注释的流程和边缘情况。

name: deliverable
example: The main deliverable this quarter is a validated journey map.
exampleTrans: 本季度的主要交付物是一份经过验证的旅程地图。

name: research repository
example: All past studies are tagged and stored in the research repository.
exampleTrans: 所有过往研究都已打标签并存入研究资料库。

name: north star
example: The north star vision shows where the experience could be in three years.
exampleTrans: 北极星愿景展示了三年后体验可能达到的样子。

name: service design
example: Service design looks at staff, systems and policies, not just screens.
exampleTrans: 服务设计关注员工、系统和政策，而不仅仅是界面。

name: cross-functional
example: Our cross-functional team includes design, research, engineering and data.
exampleTrans: 我们的跨职能团队包括设计、研究、工程和数据。

name: expert review
example: An expert review is a fast way to spot obvious problems.
exampleTrans: 专家评审是发现明显问题的快速方法。

name: cognitive walkthrough
example: We did a cognitive walkthrough to see what a new user would expect.
exampleTrans: 我们做了认知走查，看看新用户会有什么预期。

name: usability issue
example: We logged fourteen usability issues, three of them critical.
exampleTrans: 我们记录了十四个可用性问题，其中三个是严重问题。

name: quick win
trans: n. 速赢项；容易见效的改进
example: Rewording the button label is a quick win we can ship this week.
exampleTrans: 修改按钮文案是本周就能上线的速赢项。

name: mixed methods
example: A mixed methods approach gave us both scale and depth.
exampleTrans: 混合方法让我们同时获得了规模和深度。

name: longitudinal study
example: A longitudinal study will show how habits change over six months.
exampleTrans: 纵向研究会展示习惯在六个月里如何变化。

name: concept testing
example: Concept testing helped us drop two ideas before any design work.
exampleTrans: 概念测试帮助我们在开始设计前就放弃了两个想法。

name: preference test
example: A preference test showed most people chose the simpler layout.
exampleTrans: 偏好测试显示大多数人选择了更简洁的布局。

name: accessibility audit
example: The accessibility audit found missing labels on every form field.
exampleTrans: 无障碍审查发现每个表单字段都缺少标签。

name: pilot
example: Always pilot the test with a colleague before real sessions.
exampleTrans: 在正式测试之前，一定要先找同事做一次预测试。

name: debrief
example: We hold a short debrief right after each session while memories are fresh.
exampleTrans: 每场测试结束后我们都会趁记忆犹新开一个简短的复盘会。

name: uncover
example: The diary study uncovered habits that never came up in interviews.
exampleTrans: 日记研究揭示了访谈中从未出现过的习惯。

name: reframe
example: The research helped us reframe the problem around trust, not speed.
exampleTrans: 研究帮助我们把问题重新界定为信任问题，而不是速度问题。

name: streamline
example: We streamlined the checkout from five steps to two.
exampleTrans: 我们把结账流程从五步精简到了两步。

name: reduce friction
example: Autofill helps reduce friction for returning customers at checkout.
exampleTrans: 自动填充有助于在结账时为回头客减少阻力。

name: emotional journey
trans: n. 情绪曲线；情感旅程
example: The emotional journey dips sharply when users wait for approval.
exampleTrans: 用户等待审批时，情绪曲线会急剧下滑。

name: proto-persona
example: We started with a proto-persona and refined it after interviews.
exampleTrans: 我们从假设型用户画像出发，并在访谈后加以完善。

name: early adopter
example: Early adopters tolerate rough edges that mainstream users will not.
exampleTrans: 早期采用者能容忍主流用户无法接受的粗糙之处。

name: power user
trans: n. 高级用户；重度用户
example: Power users asked for keyboard shortcuts and bulk actions.
exampleTrans: 高级用户要求增加键盘快捷键和批量操作。

name: context of use
example: The context of use is a noisy kitchen with wet hands.
exampleTrans: 使用情境是一个嘈杂的厨房，而且双手是湿的。

name: expectation
example: The result did not match the participant's expectation, so she went back.
exampleTrans: 结果与参与者的预期不符，于是她返回了上一步。

name: perception
example: A progress indicator improves the perception of speed.
exampleTrans: 进度指示器能改善对速度的感知。

name: decision fatigue
example: Too many plan options lead to decision fatigue.
exampleTrans: 套餐选项太多会导致决策疲劳。

name: Hick's law
example: Hick's law explains why the long menu slowed people down.
exampleTrans: 希克定律解释了为什么长菜单会拖慢人们的速度。

name: Fitts's law
example: According to Fitts's law, the tiny close button is hard to hit.
exampleTrans: 根据菲茨定律，这个很小的关闭按钮很难点中。

name: wayfinding
example: Clear breadcrumbs support wayfinding in a deep help center.
exampleTrans: 清晰的面包屑导航有助于在层级很深的帮助中心中寻路。

name: breadcrumb
example: Participants used the breadcrumb to go back to the category page.
exampleTrans: 参与者用面包屑导航返回到分类页面。

name: content strategy
example: Content strategy decides what we say, where, and to whom.
exampleTrans: 内容策略决定了我们说什么、在哪说、对谁说。

name: taxonomy
example: The new taxonomy uses the words customers actually search for.
exampleTrans: 新的分类体系采用了客户实际搜索的词汇。
